description_en: Situated on the western side of Dupāt Square, theDāphāBhajanaPhalcāis located to the north of the large five-storey building that also houses theKṛṣi UdayaPrimary School. A shrine to DupātGaṇeśastands in front of the Phalcā. The narrow alley to its north leads to Subahāl, while the alley to its south points to Tyāgaḥ.This was once a six-bayed Phalcā and was part ofdāphāguthichẽ(broken down, this means a house (=chẽ) of aguthithat supports the performance ofdāphāmusic) which has a tradition of displaying two Bhairāvas during the festival of Indrayātrā. Dāphā Bhajana Phalcāwas dismantled in 2002 and then integrated into the five-storey concrete community building. Before 2004, it had two storeys and six bays (see historical photographs). The upper floor held paintings of the deities Gaṇeśa and Kumāra and its tiled roof was supported by plain struts. After 2004, the old Phalcā was dismantled and reconstructed in a new RCC structure with five storeys. The ground floor is still used fordāphāperformances. The community runs an e-library on the first floor.The artistic bricks are the only features of the Phalcā that provide it with a traditional feel. However, the use of bricks displaying lion faces on top of the Phalcā give it quite an unusual appearance, since such bricks are far more commonly used in temples. A wide opening at the front gives the Phalcā even more of an unconventional look. It has been divided into two bays by a single large pillar at its centre, and is protected by metal railings.No inscription regarding the monument's initial construction could be found. However, three inscriptions have been attached to its walls. Two of these relate the story of the renovation of the nearbyGaṇeśashrine whilst one provides a record of the Phalcā'srecent reconstruction.
description_ne: यो फल्चा दुपाट टोलको पश्चिममा अवस्थित रहेको छ । फल्चाको सामुन्ने दुपाटको स्थान गणेश रहेको छ । सन् २००४ मा ढलान गरेर नयाँ भवन बनाउनुभन्दा अघि यो फल्चा दुईतल्लाको थियो । भुइँतल्लामा ६ कवल बनाइएका थिए । माथिल्लो तल्लामा गणेश, कुमार अंकित चित्रहरू बनाइएका थिए । फल्चामा झिंगटीको छाना राखिएको थियो । पुरानो फल्चा भत्काएर अहिले ढलान गरेर पाँच तल्लाको भवन बनाइएको छ । फल्चाको भुइँतल्लामा फलामको रेलिङ्ग हाली ढोका बनाई भजन गर्नकै लागि छुट्याइएको छ । पहिलो तल्लामा टोलवासीको लागि विद्युतीय पुस्तकालय संचालन गरिएको छ । दोस्रो तल्लादेखि माथि कृषि उदय प्राथमिक विद्यालय संचालन गरिएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
references: Sources and references Sources The inscription at the shrine of Gaṇeśa of Dupāt was also published in Vajracharya (1999,100). Details Śrī Gaṇeśāya namaḥ | Buddhāya- namaḥ Dharmmāya namaḥ Sañghāya na- ma || Svamvat 771 Bhādra padre śukla pratipadāntithau pūrvvaphālguyā nakṣetre Śivayoge, Vṛhaspativāsa- re: thwa kunhu Dopāta Kothvanani, Vi- jayasiṃha Bhāvo Chekajhita, murgudi- cheyā : thaṃkādi Pālasiṃha Bhado(vo) pra- maṣina, Gunirā Dharmma gvaṣṭhi sa- mūhana doyāta rāchi tvaṃ ciña --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- yāka Homage to Lord Ganeś. Homage to Lord Buddha, Dharma and Sañgha. On Thursday, the first day of the bright lunar fortnight of Bhādra in NS 771 (1651 AD), a team of Guṃlā Dharma Guthi paved the Dupāt lāchi (road) with brick. (provisionary translation by Rajendra Shakya, 2016)

historical_events.event_description: Reconstruction with the support of the Association of Assistance for Education in Nepal, Mitra Japan and Dupāt Tol Sudhār Samiti.
This inscription has nothing to do with theDāphāBhajanaPhalcā. However, it records the paving of the path that passes in front of the Phalcāin 1651 CE.
